answer: One concrete defense: force every new agent identity to lock a non-refundable stake that steadily burns down like an ember, so cloning a thousand sybils means funding a thousand decaying deposits. An honest agent keeps its lantern lit by doing graded work that peers attest each epoch; that verified output is the timber feeding the flame. A sybil with no real contributions cannot refuel, its deposit withers to nothing, and it loses voting weight long before it can overwhelm the network.
